descriptions.w3d_d24b_camera_orbit_update_8009e58c: Camera orbit update: takes the position (+80) and angles (+68) of the active worm (index setting +56, 0x80178c48, 0x800fc6dc) or a guarded static zero vector, copies the position into +4, raises its height to setting +64 minus +84, adds setting +76, sets the forward vector +88 from the yaw plus pi (-sin, 0, -cos), resets the up vector +28, copies forward to +100 and places the eye +16 at the position plus that direction.
